decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the red-marked toilet location and washing-machine placement beside the shower; no stale candidate attribute requires removal.
The marked fixture changes are tied to the Unit 1 bathroom context and do not necessarily alter Unit 3's separately specified left-wall drain and shower layout.
Changing fixture locations in the Unit 1 bathrooms does not alter Unit 3's kitchen-counter placement or bathroom-door clearance constraints.
The source does not identify Unit 2 or necessarily change its bathroom-door position, toilet drain constraint, or other current layout attributes.
The red and yellow marks in the source identify bathroom fixture locations, not changes to the existing wall preservation, demolition, or construction policy.
The bathroom fixture relocation does not necessarily change the common entrance partition, corridor allocation, or Unit 1 incorporated common area.
The source changes bathroom fixtures only and leaves the open-plan kitchen configuration and cabinet quantities and dimensions unchanged.
Repositioning bathroom fixtures does not change Unit 1's 2+1 room program or its bedroom and living-area counts.
The source does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The Unit 1 bathroom fixture changes are unrelated to retaining or conditionally enclosing the Unit 3 balcony.
